stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 8,656 applied, 5,977 admitted (69.1%), 676 enrolled. The in-state, out-of-state and international rows plus an 'unknown residency' column (69 applied, 45 admitted, 4 enrolled; not shown as a field) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 348 applied, 242 admitted, 43 enrolled. No early decision plan (C21 'No'); Early Action counts are not reported. Waitlist: 273 offered a place, 200 accepted, 172 admitted. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (C11); no student had a GPA below 1.0, and the average of 3.61 (C12) covers 98.22% of the class. Pacific is test-optional: only 104 enrolled first-years (15.38%) submitted the SAT and 25 (3.70%) the ACT, so the SAT/ACT percentiles describe a small group. The CDS leaves the student-to-faculty ratio (I-2) blank, so the ratio of 13 to 1 is the IPEDS figure from College Navigator. Undergraduate enrollment (3,097) and the nonresident count (214) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B1 and B2.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set (G1, G5). It ticks '2026-27 costs not available' (final figures due 5/1/2026), so these are read as the 2025-26 figures: tuition $57,824, required fees $1,020, food and housing $17,546 (housing $9,876 + food $7,670). Estimated expenses: books $1,089, transportation $1,540, other $2,780 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour tuition $1,995. Pacific's current Cost of Attendance page (no year printed) lists tuition $59,560, fees $1,200, housing $9,876 and food $7,900 for a full-time student. Tuition is the same for domestic and international students. CDS H6: both institutional need-based and non-need-based aid are available to degree-seeking nonresidents; 172 nonresidents received institutional aid, average $44,931 (total $7,728,070).
